description: Utility-event timelines and background information cover selected US metropolitan water systems through 2020, including legal settings, climate, demographics and sources. This resource is provided by Margaret Garcia; Adam Wiechman; Sara Alonso Vicario and coauthors. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike CC BY-SA.. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The description states 16 utilities but its displayed city list has 15 entries. Do not resolve the count without checking the files. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
